{{Quote|Fortunately for you, you have caught the ''Icarii-7'' in a rare moment of idleness. Have no fear, your safety is sure to be short-lived. We shall soon ply the stars and terrorize your cargo once again. Now, be gone before you inspire us to villainy yet again.|A prerecorded message by Skahvi that projected from their ship if disturbed while being repaired|<ref name="Friends Like These" />}}
'''Skahvi Renlow''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], where they preyed upon [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Forces, particularly [[Prison/Legends|prison]] ships, traveling across [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] routes. The Togruta owned the [[BT-900 bulk transport/Legends|BT-900 bulk transport]] ''[[Icarii-7/Legends|Icarii-7]]''. At one point before the [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|Battle of Xorrn]], the ''Icarii-7'' was being repaired and upgraded at [[Foundry Four/Legends|Foundry Four]] on the planet of [[Xorrn/Legends|Xorrn]]. Their [[Skahvi Renlow's crew/Legends|crew]] mostly consisted of convicts and former [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />
